question: At what dollar threshold does UC policy require competitive bidding for purchases?
ground_truth: Under BFB-BUS-43, competitive bidding is required for purchases that exceed $100,000 annually. Any purchase or aggregate spending with a supplier that surpasses this threshold must go through a competitive bidding process.

Rule: Competitive bid required at $100,000 or more (BUS-43: more than $100,000 annually, aggregated per supplier; CA Public Contract Code). The same $100,000 bid threshold applies to federal funds because the CA PCC is stricter than the $350,000 federal Simplified Acquisition Threshold.

ground_truth: Yes, competitive bidding is required. Under BFB-BUS-43, the $100,000 threshold applies to purchases on an annual aggregate basis, not per transaction. Even though each individual order is well under $100,000, the combined annual spend of $125,000 with that single vendor exceeds the $100,000 threshold, triggering the competitive bidding requirement. You should work with your procurement office to initiate a competitive solicitation before continuing to place orders with that vendor.

Rule: Documentation required for a business meal or entertainment expense (BUS-79): type of expense; type of event; number of participants with a guest list giving each participant's name, title and occupation or group affiliation; date and location; the business-related purpose of the occasion; and the signature, printed name and department of the approving authority (plus the host's signature for entertainment, recruitment and morale-building events). Expenses of $75 or more per occasion need original itemized receipts.
Source: BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "The completed request must include the following information:"; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "Type of expense (lunch, dinner, etc.);"; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "Type of event;"; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "Number of participants (attach a guest list containing the name and title of participants, and their occupation or group affiliation, in order to establish the business-related relationship to the University)"; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "Date and location of the event;"; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "Business-related nature of the occasion or purpose of the event; and"; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "The signature, printed name, and department of the department head or approving authority."; BFB-BUS-79: Expenditures for Business Meetings, Entertainment, and Other Occasions (UC-FA-22-0617 (updated 12.15.2022, accessible)), p.17, IV.B.1 Reimbursement or Payment Request: "Expenses of $75 or more per occasion must be supported by original itemized receipts"
Conditions: The report must include a complete guest list with each participant's name, title, and occupation or group affiliation, along with the business-related purpose of the occasion and the signature of the approving authority [1].
